subject: Release closure cadence & go-live checklist | CardioSense
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@cardiosense.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-14T16:02:00Z
Subject: Release closure cadence & go-live checklist | CardioSense

Alex —

Following up from last week's demo, attaching the most recent MAP and the proposed cutover runbook (see attachments). This week's goal: lock owners for the remaining closing tasks and confirm a dry-run date. High-level checklist / status below:

- Launch target: 2027-04-05 (candidate) — still tentative until we confirm DB maintenance window and legal sign-off.
- MAP version: v7 attached (primary tracker).
- Cutover runbook: cutover_runbook_v2.pdf attached — includes step-by-step deploy + smoke tests.
- Rollback approach: blue/green with traffic switch and fast rollback endpoint; detailed playbook in rollback_playbook.md (attached).

This week’s checkpoint asks:
1) CardioSense to confirm production DB maintenance window (owner: Alex) — needed by Tue 2027-03-16 EOD.
2) Redwood infra to validate KV cache warmup script on staging and estimate warmup time (owner: Ben) — deliverable Wed 2027-03-17.
3) CS to confirm monitoring pages & alert thresholds (owner: Monica) — checklist items in MAP tab "Monitoring".
4) Legal sign-off on SSO and retention addendum (owner: Laura) — status update by Thu 2027-03-18.

Proposed standing: weekly sync on Mondays 10:00 PT until cutover. I'll schedule a 30-min working session for tomorrow to walk owners through the runbook.

Attachments: CardioSense_MAP_v7.xlsx (tracker), cutover_runbook_v2.pdf, rollback_playbook.md

Thanks —
Karthik
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Mercer <alex@cardiosense.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@cardiosense.io>
Date: 2027-03-15T09:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Release closure cadence & go-live checklist | CardioSense

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear breakdown and the attachments. Quick responses inline:

- DB maintenance window: We can take a 2-hour window on 2027-04-04 02:00-04:00 UTC (overnight for our users). That works for schema locks but I need confirmation that there is a rollback path for the data migration.
- Monitoring: I'll have Taylor own the alerts; Taylor — please confirm thresholds and whether Redwood's tracing hooks require additional config.
- Legal: we're expediting the retention addendum — we expect sign-off by Thu 2027-03-18.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood provide an estimate for expected 95th percentile latency during peak traffic in the first hour post-cutover? We'll use that for our customer comms.
- Can you attach the dry-run playbook you intend to run in staging?

I'll review the MAP v7 and return comments by tonight.

Best,
Alex
Head of Product
CardioSense

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@cardiosense.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-16T13:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Release closure cadence & go-live checklist | CardioSense

Alex/Taylor —

I've attached a short staging dry-run checklist below (also added as a tab in the MAP). Plan is to execute a full dry-run on 2027-03-29; invite to follow. Highlights:

- Pre-dry-run: sync infra flags, seed test accounts (owner: Ben), validate monitoring dashboards in staging (owner: Monica).
- Dry-run day: run scripted deploy, run smoke tests, execute failover to rollback endpoint, measure warmup time and KV cache hit ratio.
- Post-dry-run: capture perf baseline, list action items with owners and ETA.

Staging dry-run checklist (excerpt):
- Deploy candidate build to staging and tag commit — owner: Ben — due 2027-03-25.
- Warmup cache script run (10M tokens equivalent) — owner: Ben — results by 2027-03-26.
- Run synthetic traffic for 30 minutes at 2x expected production peak — owner: Monica — 2027-03-29.
- Verify error budget and alerts fire correctly — owner: Monica — post-test log.

I'll email the calendar invite for the dry-run once Ben confirms the staging commit window.

Monica Patel
Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Alex Mercer <alex@cardiosense.io>
Date: 2027-03-17T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Release closure cadence & go-live checklist | CardioSense

Quick infra notes and estimates:

- KV cache warmup: running the warmup script in staging yields ~6–8 minutes to reach the target hit ratio for the current model/seq length mix. We'll include a 15-minute warmup window in the runbook to be conservative.
- 95th percentile latency estimate: during a 2x synthetic peak on staging we measured 260–320ms for the primary generation endpoint (95th). We'll provide a final number after the dry-run once we have production-like data.
- Rollback mechanics: we have a documented fast rollback that flips the traffic weight back to the previous model endpoint and restores previous DB snapshot if migration fails. Critical dependency: confirm you can support restore from the pre-migration snapshot within 1 hour; otherwise fallback will be partial feature toggle only.

Action items updated in MAP (v7):
- Ben: seed staging and run warmup script by 2027-03-26.
- Karthik: schedule dry-run calendar and confirm attendees by 2027-03-18.
- Alex: confirm DB snapshot/restore SLA with ops by 2027-03-16.

Ben
Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Alex Mercer <alex@cardiosense.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-18T08:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Release closure cadence & go-live checklist | CardioSense

Alex / Karthik —

Legal has completed a narrow retention addendum focused on event logs and API request metadata. I have uploaded the redline to the HubSpot deal record and shared the DocuSign powerform link below. Please confirm that the addendum content matches your expectations; once CardioSense signs we'll consider legal sign-off complete.

Next steps:
- CardioSense review + signature via DocuSign powerform — requested by 2027-03-18 EOD.
- Once signed, I will countersign and send an executed copy to both teams.

Link: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning?env=prod&bf=cardio-approval

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Mercer <alex@cardiosense.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-18T11:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Release closure cadence & go-live checklist | CardioSense

Team —

All good on our side: Taylor signed the DocuSign powerform (receipt attached to reply). Ops confirmed they can snapshot and restore within 45 minutes, so the full rollback path is acceptable. We also confirm the proposed 02:00-04:00 UTC window on 2027-04-04 for the DB migration.

Confirmed items:
- Launch target: firm for 2027-04-05 (post-maintenance).
- Dry-run: 2027-03-29 as planned.
- Monitoring owner: Taylor (will post thresholds in MAP by EOD).

I'll be on the dry-run and cutover calls. Thanks for the clear owners — moving to closed for the current action items in MAP.

Best,
Alex
Head of Product
CardioSense
